messages:
Alex Kim: :rotating_light: paging — alerting on p99 latency spike for streaming endpoints in shared-gpu-pool-2. p95 also elevated. Seeing streaming stalls reported by customer telemetry.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3079. Assigned to on-call: Maya Patel. Priority: P1.
Maya Patel: I'm on it. Starting triage — collecting perf metrics and recent deployments. Any active rollouts?
Jordan S: no deploys in last 30m from release pipeline. Latest was ~2h ago.
Alex Kim: loads show a sudden p99 jump from ~180ms -> ~1.2s at ~6202024500. p95 moved from 120ms -> 400ms.
Maya Patel: confirming customer impact? Which tenants?
Alex Kim: metrics tag shows 6 tenants with elevated latency, tenant-42 and tenant-77 worst. Streaming stall traces show long NVME waits in kernel.
SRE Lead: probably noisy-tenant IO. Check cgroup writeback and per-tenant iops.
Maya Patel: pulling host-level stats now.
Maya Patel: on host gpunode-19, disk writeback spiking, iostat showing 1500ms avg await on nvme0n1. GPU utilization OK, but topology shows many small jobs with high checkpointing.
Jordan S: looking at cgroups: tenant-77 cgroup blkio.throttle.io_service_bytes shows sustained high writes. Might be causing kernel writeback congestion.
Alex Kim: streaming worker logs show repeated stalls and `streaming: flush_kv_cache` calls coincident with the spikes. Code snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:28:12Z stream_worker[pid=2312] WARN stall_detected duration=820ms reason=nvme_io
2026-03-15T10:28:13Z stream_worker[pid=2312] INFO evicting prefixes count=24
```
Maya Patel: good find. If KV cache eviction is thrashing due to IO, that can cascade latency. Any recent model changes that increase checkpoint writes?
Jordan S: no model pushes. But tenant-77 started a heavy background embedding job ~10:20 UTC. Scheduler shows it got a burst slot on shared pool.
SRE Lead: we need live mitigation: throttle or evict background job, or migrate it to dedicated pool. Who can reach tenant-77 owner?
Ops: pinged tenant-77 owner via email and in app. Also placed temporary QoS limit on their scheduling token to reduce IO burst.
Alex Kim: applying cgroup throttle for tenant-77 now: `echo "8:0 1048576" > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-77/blkio.throttle.read_bps_device` (simulating). Will monitor.
Maya Patel: after throttle, p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 460ms in first 90s. p95 back to ~210ms. Progressing.
incident-bot: Note: change recorded in incident timeline by Maya Patel.
Jordan S: still seeing occasional stalls at ~10-20% of requests, tail ~700ms. Might be other tenants contributing.
Alex Kim: checking NVMe queue depth across nodes — multiple tenants doing small IO bursts. Could be eviction churn.
SRE Lead: next step: schedule evacuation of the largest noisy tenant (tenant-42) off shared-gpu-pool-2 to dedicated-burst-1. Can we drain without impacting active sessions?
Maya Patel: we have active streaming sessions for tenant-42 (~30). We should use graceful migration: canary-migrate 10% of incoming requests, monitor error/latency, then ramp.
Jordan S: kicking off canary migrate script. Command: `./scripts/canary-migrate --from=shared-gpu-pool-2 --to=dedicated-burst-1 --tenant=tenant-42 --pct=10`
Alex Kim: logs show canary push succeeded. Early signals: canary requests p99 ~120ms.
Maya Patel: ramping to 50% over next 3 minutes. Watch for rollbacks.
CustomerSuccess Bot: Notifying CS: we have mitigation in progress, informing affected customers.
SRE Lead: also create a short-term routing policy to prefer cached-model-variants to reduce KV writes: `route.policy = prefer_cached_variants=true` — ops can flip.
Ops: applied routing flag. Immediate reduction in eviction rate.
Maya Patel: p99 now ~220ms cluster-wide. Streaming stalls rare. We're stabilizing.
Jordan S: opening follow-up tasks: 1) identify tenant IO patterns and add better admission control; 2) add per-tenant writeback limits at scheduler; 3) add runbook steps for live KV cache eviction mitigation.
Alex Kim: I'll draft the customer impact blurb: affected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-13, tenant-8, tenant-90, tenant-21. Duration ~10:20–10:38 UTC. Visible effect: elevated p99 and intermittent streaming stalls, degraded streaming frame rates for a subset.
Maya Patel: recommend post-incident: evaluate autoscaling decoupling for background embedding jobs and enforce off-peak windows for heavy IO tasks.
SRE Lead: agree. Also propose a short-term policy: disallow background embeddings on shared pools during business hours by default.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3079 status: mitigated. Root cause: multi-tenant NVMe writeback/congestion from background embedding job causing KV cache thrashing and streaming stalls. Action items assigned.
Jordan S: assigning Jira INC-3079-POSTMORTEM to Alex Kim and Maya Patel.
Alex Kim: thanks team. I'll update the incident doc and send a summary to impacted customers via CS.
Maya Patel: I'll schedule a retro tomorrow and add metrics to alert thresholds (streaming stall rate, kv-evict-rate).
CustomerSuccess Bot: Customer notification draft queued for review.
SRE Lead: Great work. Closing the live handoff.
Alex Kim: :thumbsup:
